messages:
maya: kicking off intake for harrier-lite (3B) INT4 bring-up. goal: hosted + dedicated + private canary plan + clear abort criteria. putting a rough checklist below, pls react with ownership and gaps.

josh: +1. do we have eval slices and baseline numbers from harrier-fp16?

maya: yes — baseline evals on harrier-fp16: exact-match 0.72, rougeL 0.65, p50 latency 85ms (hosted), cost/token baseline. i'll attach quant results later.

lin: for INT4 experiments, i'm curious about degeneration on long-context. we should add prompts with >2k tokens.

maya: added long-context slice to smoke.

rachel: proposed high-level canary matrix: 1) Hosted small canary (5% traffic) for 48h 2) Dedicated reserved canary (10% traffic) for 72h 3) Private customer pilot — manual rollout. each step needs automated checks + manual signoff.

owen: suggest these automated checks:
- perf: p50 < 120ms hosted, p95 < 500ms
- accuracy: no regression > 1.5% absolute on weighted eval set
- hallucination: named-entity hallucination increase < 0.8%
- token churn: output length distribution within +-8%

josh: add KV cache correctness check: cold vs warm vs resumed session outputs identical (within tolerance).

maya: yep. also include prefix cache warmup metrics and continuous batching effects.

rachel: fallback plan: route failures or abort -> harrier-fp16 (same model family FP16) or tern-7b if capacity constrained. fallback priority: 1) harrier-fp16 2) tern-7b.

lin: what's the canary traffic split plan? start 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h windows?

maya: proposed timeline: hosted: 1% for 2h, 5% for 12h, 20% for 24h. abort if any automated check trips. dedicated: 10% for 24h, 50% for 24–48h, then scale. private: manual signoff after dedicated.

owen: operational knobs to include in rollout config:
- max_batch_tokens: 1024
- max_batch_delay_ms: 15
- kv_cache_prefetch: on
- quant_profile: int4-default-v2

maya: put a sample route config for hosted canary: 
```json
{"route": "/v1/generate/harrier-lite", "canary": {"percent": 5, "duration_h": 48, "abort_on": ["latency_p95>500","accuracy_drop>1.5"]}, "fallback": ["harrier-fp16","tern-7b"]}
```

josh: nice. we should wire these to console feature flags so we can flip quickly. add rollout ID and tracing header in requests for attribution.

rachel: CI smoke tests to run on deploy:
- unit inference sanity (n=50)
- perf microbench (p50/p95)
- consistency tests (cold vs warm)
- regression eval run (weighted)

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued: harrier-lite-int4/smoke -> 12 jobs. ETA ~ 18m.

deploy-bot: Hosted canary deploy started (canary_id=harrier-lite-20260301-01)

lin: monitoring/alerts (proposals):
- increase in error rate > 0.5% absolute in 10m
- latency_p95 > 500ms for 5m
- eval_accuracy_drop > 1.5% on rolling 1h window
- hallucination_count% increase > 0.8% on eval slice

maya: sample PromQL alert for latency: 
```promql
avg_over_time(request_duration_ms_p95[5m]) > 500
```

owen: add automated rollback window: if any alert triggers in canary window, rollback to previous route for 30m, notify oncall and owners.

rachel: runbook for private deploy: ensure KMS binding + audit log export enabled, config snapshot, offline installer vetting. add manual checklist item: customer acceptance tests (CAT) pass.

josh: quant experiments summary so far: int4-default-v2 gives 1.1% accuracy drop vs fp16 on general mix, but minimal latency improvements for short prompts; cost reduced ~35% token compute. we need targeted eval on instruction-following and code-gen slices.

maya: action items:
- lin: run long-context regression + edge-case hallucination tests (ETA 2 days)
- josh: finalize quant profile matrix + perf runs on hosted infra (ETA 2 days)
- rachel: draft canary config in console + owner rollouts (ETA EOD)
- owen: create Prometheus alerts + dashboard (ETA 1 day)
- maya: coordinate private pilot checklist and customer comms (ETA 3 days)

rachel: tagging owners in rollout policy: @eng-sre for alerts, @platform for routing changes, @solutions for private pilot comms.

nowen: small test curl for smoke:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"Summarize: <long doc>"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate/harrier-lite | jq .
```

maya: thanks all. if no major objections i'll start the hosted canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. react :thumbsup: to approve.

josh: :thumbsup:

lin: :thumbsup:

rachel: :thumbsup:

owen: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for 1845200400.
